6.description: [The Botanica] [Commander Sarannis] Reduced the frequency Commander Sarannis applied Arcane Resonance to her target.
[The Botanica] Removed immunity to attack-speed reduction from a number of creatures.
[The Botanica] Rebalanced a few creatures that got missed during league. All creatures inside The Botanica no longer follow the Parry Hasten rules.

0.description: Corrected an issue where Nature's Grasp was reporting as a rankable ability.
Corrected an issue where generic abilities were reporting as rankable.
Corrected an issue where players would teleport and respawn in the middle of Uldaman instead of the beginning of Uldaman when queueing through LFG.
Reduced the Scarlet Scryer's Sleep duration to 5 seconds (down from 30 seconds) in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard.

5.description: Pending Restarts: The Mythic Version of Cowl of the Guiltless will no longer have Resilience and will have PvE Power instead of PvP Power.
Pending Restarts: Fused Wiring now has a 1 copper sell price.
Pending Restarts: The following crafting materials purchasable from vendors are now stackable to 100: Threats, Flux, Parchments, Dye, Wood, Spices, Flour.

Pending Restarts: The following item types are now stackable to 100: Explosives (Engineering), Devices such as Repair Bots and Target Dummies (Engineering), Skeleton Keys (Blacksmithing), Leather Scraps (Skinning/Leatherworking).

Pending Restarts: The following item types are now stackable to 100: Craftable Bandages, Anti Venom, Sharpening Stones, Weight Stones, Runes (Blacksmithing), Weapon Oils (Alchemy), Nets (Tailoring), Baits (Fishing).

6.description: [Karazhan] [Prince Malchezaar] Amplify Damage no longer targets pets.
[The Opening of the Dark Portal] Corrected an issue where Mythic Bosses would not drop loot.

0.description: Pending Restart: Allow to silence Motherloads, Outland PvP Events, Game Mode Deaths and Completions with .chatsettings

6.description: [Mana-Tombs] [Pandemonius] Reduced the damage dealt by Pandemonius Dark Shield by 50%. Dark Shield now has a 50% chance to reflect spells down from 100%.
[Sethekk Halls] Cobalt Serpents Lightning Breath will no longer target pets.
[The Opening of the Dark Portal] All creatures and bosses within the dungeon no longer follow the parry hasten rules.

[The Opening of the Dark Portal] All creatures within the dungeon have gotten a balance review on Heroic difficulty. Health and damage dealt of all creatures and bosses is now in line with the other TBC heroic dungeons.
[The Opening of the Dark Portal] Removed a number of unnecessary immunitys from Rift Lords and Rift Keepers such as immune to disease on all difficulties.
[The Opening of the Dark Portal] Corrected an issue where alternate versions of specific summoned creatures would spawn in place of a false base creature or not spawn at all on all difficulties.
[The Opening of the Dark Portal ] Corrected an issue where Time Rifts would spawn creature waves twice.
[The Opening of the Dark Portal ] Corrected an issue where bosses inherited Leagues double loot.
[Gruuls Lair] [Maulgar] Mighty Blow now ignores Line of Sight.

[Auchenai Crypts] Reduced the damage increase applied to player by Auchenai Soulpriests Shadow Bolt to 10% down from 50% and reduced the effects duration to 6 seconds down from 10 seconds on all difficulties.

0.description: Mythic Dungeons will now correctly reward reputation on Kill.
Pending Restart: .character list now works similar to .chatsettings and allows you to activate / disable characters in an easier way.

5.description: Renamed the Lightning Bolt triggered by The Lightning Capacitor to Captured Lightning. Change will be visible in game with next patch update.
Fixed a logic hole in some aura stack incrementation implementations.
Fixed an issue where the Reclaiming Auchindoun event counters would randomly reset.
Fixed an issue where outdoor PvP was missing gameobjects, preventing participation.
Improved the reliability of the Outlaw Pardon's reputation reset.
Corrected an issue where the Outlaw Pardon sometimes failed to remove the Outlaw aura.
Beatmaster Whistles now initially dismiss the pet they summon. This will prevent pets from being summoned with inaccurate pet scaling.
Improved the AI of the Dark Arrow skeletons.
Corrected an issue where higher ranks of Prayer of Fortitude and Gift of the Wild would be unlearned when switching specializations.
Added the Subtle Slam Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Powerful Slam Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Subtle Mind Flay Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Focused Mind Flay Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Accrual Mind Flay Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Brutal Mind Flay Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Steady Mind Flay Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Critical Mind Flay Mystic Enchantment.
Added the Taunting Mind Flay Mystic Enchantment.
Fixed an issue where the Boom Boom Mystic Enchantment was not scaling Fire Nova damage properly.
Removed race restriction on many early quests.
You can no longer accept "Wildcard: Silas Darkmoon's Fortune" if Wildcard is not enabled.
Spawned a mailbox at Westbrook Garrison.

[Mana-Tombs] Reduced the melee damage of Nexus Terror on all difficulties by 60% to compensate their ability to ignore armor by dealing Shadow instead of Physical damage with their attacks.
